Name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
Summary: Maher-shalal-hash-baz, whose name means 'swift to the spoil, hasty to the prey,' was Isaiah's son, named by God's command as a sign that Assyria would soon plunder Damascus and Samaria.
KeyStory: Before the child could cry 'my father' or 'my mother,' the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria would be taken away before the king of Assyria.
LifeLesson: God's signs can be uncomfortable — this child's name announced judgment, not comfort.
